# toTextDecoration

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`TextDecorationInput`](text-decoration-input.md) to the [`TextDecoration`](text-decoration.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toTextDecoration(input: TextDecorationInput): TextDecoration
```
